name: save-boot-4-model-nmkin-1
description: #99 (diagnostic): boot from the generated save harness/saves/disc1-nmkin-1.json (nmkin_1, field ID 0x78 per ff7-flat-wiki Field_ID; triangle 0, x 0x7FFF so the game places the player at that triangle's centroid, as #38 did; progress 6 and Cloud alone as at md1stin, not this field's own values, which no source documents). Load as save-boot-1-load does, then 60 still frames and a walk up 40 and right 40 frames. Reports whether the field loaded (w_field, load_done, map_cur), the player model index candidates (g_PlayerModelId, FieldState.pcModelId) and the sign of the PosX change of field models 0-2 (mv0..mv2). Looks for a field where the player is not model 0. Only small integers leave.

map_cur.description: g_FieldCurrentMap (s16 as u16; confirmed #77): the field ID.

loading.description: g_IsFieldLoading (s16 as u16; confirmed #77): 2 in a settled field.

player_model.description: g_PlayerModelId (s16 as u16): the player's field model index; 0 at md1stin (#77, #38). Xeeynamo/ff7-decomp@9411173 (reference only, no code) config/symbols.main.us.txt

pc_model.description: FieldState (0x8009ABF4) + 0x2A pcModelId (s16 as u16): a second player-index candidate; 0 at md1stin (#77 attempt 1). Xeeynamo/ff7-decomp@9411173 (reference only, no code) include/game.h FieldState

x0.description: g_FieldEntity[0].PosX (0x80074EA4 + 0*0x84 + 0x0C; s32 as u32): field model 0. Element 0 confirmed #77. Xeeynamo/ff7-decomp@9411173 (reference only, no code) symbols.main.us.txt, include/game.h FieldEntity

x1.description: g_FieldEntity[1].PosX (0x80074EA4 + 1*0x84 + 0x0C; s32 as u32): field model 1. Element 0 confirmed #77. Xeeynamo/ff7-decomp@9411173 (reference only, no code) symbols.main.us.txt, include/game.h FieldEntity

x2.description: g_FieldEntity[2].PosX (0x80074EA4 + 2*0x84 + 0x0C; s32 as u32): field model 2. Element 0 confirmed #77. Xeeynamo/ff7-decomp@9411173 (reference only, no code) symbols.main.us.txt, include/game.h FieldEntity
